methodology_other:
For this project we used PlanetScope 3m resolution imagery to assess road damage in Mozambique following the flooding.

We asked 15 volunteers to categorise every one image on the Zooniverse platform. We asked volunteers to identify road blockages (caused by flooding or debris) within the imagery.

We generated a consensus from the raw data, and visualised this as a point dataset. The markings were then compared to satellite imagery by an expert.

South Sofala and Maputo Road Level Categorised: primary, secondary, tertiary

To see more about the project, you can view the project [here](https://www.zooniverse.org/projects/alicemead/planetary-response-network-mozambique-flooding-2026).
name: mozambique-flooding-road-blockages
notes:
We have assessed primary, secondary, and tertiary roads for road blockages (flooding or debris) for Maputo and South Sofala in Mozambique following flooding.

The data is held in a shapefile format using the WGS 84 EPSG: 4326 projection.
 
You can find the Planetary Response Network Mozambique Flooding 2026 project we ran [here](https://www.zooniverse.org/projects/alicemead/planetary-response-network-mozambique-flooding-2026).
